definitions.explanation: the operation or running of industrial facilities, factories, or machinery

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}が{操業|そうぎょう}を{開始|かいし}した。
{操業|そうぎょう}{率|りつ}が{低下|ていか}している。
{事故|じこ}で{操業|そうぎょう}を{停止|ていし}した。
examples.english: Operations were halted due to an accident.

notes:
{操業|そうぎょう} refers specifically to the operation of industrial facilities.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {操|そう} (operate, control, manipulate)
- {業|ぎょう} (business, industry)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {操業|そうぎょう}する (to operate - suru verb)
- {操業|そうぎょう}{率|りつ} (operating rate, capacity utilization)
- {操業|そうぎょう}{停止|ていし} (suspension of operations)
- {操業|そうぎょう}{短縮|たんしゅく} (reduced operations)
- フル{操業|そうぎょう} (full-capacity operation)
- {試験|しけん}{操業|そうぎょう} (trial operation)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Commonly used in manufacturing, industrial, and economic contexts
- {操業|そうぎょう}を{再開|さいかい}する (to resume operations)
- {操業|そうぎょう}を{続|つづ}ける (to continue operations)
